name: Verdigris City
chat: Welcome to Verdigris City! Mind the traffic, the cars only stop for pedestrians and pigeons.
Capital Tower has forty floors. I’ve only seen six of them.
The Capital Outlet sells last season from every boutique. Same prices, more mirrors.
The golden coin on the plaza is solid gold. Don’t lick it. I tried.
Rent here is a Billie’s favourite snack.
The park by the pond is the quietest place in town. Except for the ducks.
Broker Bea battles anyone on the plaza. She calls it “market research”.
The upper street has the best view of the fountain.

props.say: Reception: “Floors 1 to 40 are all the same company.”
City Hall: “The mayor is in a meeting about meetings.”
Food truck: “Lunch for the 1%: one per cent off.”

props.label: Verdigris Park
props.say: Verdigris Park. Free to all, like the sun that keeps it green.
